<set-variable name="sig-header" value="@{
        var key = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("sig-key");
        var ttl = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("sig-ttl", 300);
        var expires = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddSeconds(ttl).ToUnixTimeSeconds();
        var data = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(context.Request.Url.Path + expires);
        using (var hmac = new HMACSHA256(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(key)))
        {
            return "HMAC " + expires + ":" + Convert.ToBase64String(hmac.ComputeHash(data));
        }
    }" />
